label: Killed in Gaza since 7 Oct 2023
definition: People recorded as killed in Gaza since 7 October 2023.

label: Injured in Gaza since 7 Oct 2023
definition: People recorded as injured in Gaza since 7 October 2023.

label: Children killed
definition: People under 18 recorded as killed.

label: Women killed
definition: Women recorded as killed.

label: Medical personnel killed
definition: Health workers recorded as killed.

label: Journalists killed
definition: Journalists and media workers recorded as killed.

label: Civil defence workers killed
definition: Emergency and rescue personnel recorded as killed.

label: Killed since the Oct 2025 ceasefire
definition: People recorded as killed since the ceasefire took effect on 10–11 October 2025, excluding bodies recovered from earlier strikes.

label: Bodies recovered since the ceasefire
definition: Bodies recovered from rubble since the ceasefire, counted separately from new deaths.

label: Named victims by age and sex
definition: Victims identified by name and ID in Ministry lists, by age group and sex.

label: Deaths from malnutrition and starvation
definition: Deaths recorded by health authorities as caused by malnutrition or starvation.

label: Died awaiting medical evacuation
definition: Patients on the medical evacuation list who died before leaving Gaza.

label: Killed while seeking aid
definition: People killed near aid distribution sites or along aid convoy routes.

label: Deaths from traumatic injury
definition: Deaths caused by traumatic injury, including those not recorded by the Ministry.

label: Violent deaths
definition: Deaths from violence over a defined period.

label: Excess non-violent deaths
definition: Non-violent deaths above the number expected from pre-war mortality rates.

label: Aid trucks entered Gaza
definition: Trucks carrying aid or goods that crossed into Gaza, as counted by the publisher.

label: Aid trucks per day
definition: Average trucks entering Gaza per day.

label: Trucks needed per day
definition: Humanitarian trucks a day the publisher says are needed to meet basic needs.

label: Medical supplies entered
definition: Tonnes of medical equipment and medicines entering Gaza.

label: UN2720 aid delivered
definition: Tonnes of UN-manifested aid delivered to Gaza's crossings in a month.

label: UN2720 aid awaiting delivery
definition: Tonnes approved by COGAT but not yet delivered to Gaza.

label: UN2720 trucks collected
definition: UN-manifested trucks collected from Gaza's crossings.

label: UN2720 trucks intercepted
definition: UN-manifested trucks intercepted in transit, by hungry people or armed actors, before reaching their destination.

label: UN2720 trucks arrived
definition: UN-manifested trucks that reached their intended destination in Gaza.

label: People in famine (IPC Phase 5)
definition: People the IPC classified in Catastrophe/Famine conditions.

label: People in Crisis or worse (IPC 3+)
definition: People the IPC classified in Phase 3 (Crisis) or worse.

label: Killed in Israel on 7 Oct 2023
definition: People killed in the Hamas-led attack on Israel on 7 October 2023.

label: Hostages taken into Gaza
definition: People abducted into Gaza on 7 October 2023.

label: Israeli security personnel killed
definition: IDF, police, Shin Bet and other security personnel killed since 7 October 2023, on all fronts.

label: Israeli soldiers killed in Gaza since the ceasefire
definition: Israeli soldiers killed in Gaza since 10 October 2025.

label: Combatants killed in Gaza, per IDF
definition: Members of armed groups the IDF says it killed in Gaza.

label: Gaza death toll, per IDF
definition: The IDF's own estimate of total deaths in Gaza.

label: Combatants killed since the ceasefire, per IDF
definition: Members of armed groups Israeli sources say were killed since 10 October 2025.

label: Hospitals partially functioning
definition: Hospitals WHO reports as at least partially functioning: open, but with their capacity to deliver services significantly affected. See the method page for WHO's definitions.

label: Hospitals not functioning
definition: Hospitals WHO reports as unable to provide any health service. See the method page for WHO's definitions.

label: Hospitals destroyed
definition: Hospitals WHO's monitoring system reports as destroyed. See the method page for WHO's definitions.

label: Attacks on health care
definition: Attacks on health facilities, transport, workers or patients recorded by WHO's Surveillance System for Attacks on Health Care.

label: People killed in attacks on health care
definition: People killed in attacks on health care recorded by WHO's Surveillance System for Attacks on Health Care.

label: Hospitals damaged in attacks
definition: Hospitals damaged in attacks on health care recorded by WHO's Surveillance System for Attacks on Health Care.

label: Structures damaged or destroyed
definition: Buildings UNOSAT sees as destroyed, severely, moderately or possibly damaged in satellite images, compared with images from before the war.

label: Structures destroyed
definition: Buildings UNOSAT classes as destroyed in satellite images.

label: Structures severely damaged
definition: Buildings UNOSAT classes as severely damaged in satellite images.

label: Structures moderately damaged
definition: Buildings UNOSAT classes as moderately damaged in satellite images.

label: Structures possibly damaged
definition: Buildings UNOSAT classes as possibly damaged in satellite images (a category it added in May 2024).

label: Share of all structures affected
definition: Damaged or destroyed structures as a share of all structures in the Gaza Strip, as stated by UNOSAT.

label: Housing units destroyed
definition: Residential units the Gaza Government Media Office reports as destroyed.

label: Educational buildings destroyed
definition: Schools, universities and other educational buildings the Gaza Government Media Office reports as destroyed.

label: Educational buildings damaged
definition: Educational buildings the Gaza Government Media Office reports as partially damaged.

label: Mosques destroyed
definition: Mosques the Gaza Government Media Office reports as destroyed.

label: Mosques damaged
definition: Mosques the Gaza Government Media Office reports as partially damaged.

label: Churches destroyed
definition: Churches the Gaza Government Media Office reports as destroyed.

label: Government buildings destroyed
definition: Government (civic) buildings the Gaza Government Media Office reports as destroyed.

label: Hospitals fully functioning
definition: Hospitals WHO reports as fully functioning: no major or systemic issues impeding the full range of expected services. See the method page for WHO's definitions.

label: Hospitals evaluated by WHO
definition: Hospitals whose status WHO's HeRAMS monitoring evaluated that month, excluding field hospitals.
